services.description: List of services managed by inetd/xinetd. Each item defines a service to expose via the Internet super-server.

name.description: Service name (e.g., 'ftp', 'telnet', 'finger'). Must match an entry in /etc/services or be a numeric port.

socket_type.description: Socket type — usually 'stream' for TCP or 'dgram' for UDP.

protocol.description: Protocol name or number — typically 'tcp' or 'udp'.

user.description: User under which the server process runs (e.g., 'root', 'nobody').

group.description: Optional group (appended to user as 'user.group'). Leave empty if not needed.

server_path.description: Absolute path to the server binary (e.g., '/usr/sbin/in.ftpd').

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the server binary.
